parole.testo: From marionet + -en- + leger, a calque from Mandarin 傀儡軍／傀儡军 (kuǐlěijūn, “puppet army”).
From marionet + -en- + staat, a calque from Mandarin 傀儡國家／傀儡国家 (kuǐlěi guójiā, “puppet state”).

parole.significato: a type of paper manufactured from calcium carbonate mixed with a high density polyethylene bonding agent; stone paper
parole.testo: From steen (“stone”) + papier (“paper”), a calque of Mandarin 石头纸 (“stone paper”).
